title: Cybersecurity-by-Design in Digital Transformation: The Qureshi Digital Transformation Risk Matrix (Q-DTRM)
content: Organizations advancing their digital transformation process now depend on cloud platforms, APIs, and automation tools together with AI-based solutions which create wider attack surfaces while increasing the speed at which business process risks spread throughout their operations (NIST, 2024; Verizon, 2025). Most programs fail to deliver lasting benefits because organizations implement cybersecurity as an afterthought instead of making it a foundational element of their security framework (Microsoft, 2025). The chapter introduces Qureshi Digital Transformation Risk Matrix (Q-DTRM) which functions as a cybersecurity-by-design governance and risk orchestration framework that assesses risks throughout various transformation stages and from critical domains which cover identity management and cloud security and application and API protection and data governance and human behavior. The system combines AI-based identity analytics with automatic compliance monitoring and executive-level performance indicators to determine which security controls and funding needs to be addressed first. Organizations can achieve better security through sector-specific case studies together with an implementation roadmap which helps them reduce breach probability while enhancing their audit preparation and enabling swift safe innovation.
